items.label: Occasional
items.text: Interiority in narration is Occasional: Only a line or two of internal thought per generation, at decision points and reactions from the POV character.

items.label: Frequent
items.text: Interiority in narration is Frequent: most beats carry a reaction in thought. The POV character's running commentary is a constant presence alongside the action.

items.label: Constant
items.text: Interiority in narration is Constant: narration is the POV character's continuous internal monologue. Every event is filtered through immediate reaction, aside, and commentary including asides that interrupt the action mid-beat.
